title: India Post GDS Gramin Dak Sevak Recruitment 2026 Online Form for Schedule II July 2026 (23757 Post)
intro: Department of Post (India Post) Government of India, has Released Official Notification for Online Application form the Recruitment Post of Gramin Village Dak Sevak (GDS) Schedule-II July 2026 in Various State Vacancy 2026 for 23757 Post.Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to India Post GDS Jobs. Online Apply Start On August 31, 2026 & Last Date for Application is September 19, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.

Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.

Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.

Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.

																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
